clips.title: The story
paras: At Lake Al'Ameth, you help Denalan tend a wooden heart taken from a corrupted timberling. After clearing away its moss, he asks you to place it in his planter and see whether it can be healed.

Denalan has scraped the foul moss from the wooden heart taken from Blackmoss the Fetid, a corrupted timberling. Yet an unnatural taint still pulses within the wood. Trusting his years of botany and soil tending, the herbalist asks you to bury the heart directly in his personal planter. He hopes the rich nutrients he blended can draw its remaining natural vitality back toward health.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have removed that foul moss from the heart, but it remains tainted...
Try placing the heart in my planter. It is filled with a nutritive soil that may cleanse and heal the heart.

clips.title: Progress
paras: This planter is filled with soil, specially prepared by Denalan.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You place the heart within the planter, and it quickly digs itself in!
A few seconds later it wriggles back out, cleansed. It pulses slightly... Beckoning for you to take it.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
